parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An id for the managed user

parameters.name: is_approved
parameters.description: If true, only show users where the management request has been accepted. If false, only show those where the request was rejected. If omitted, shows all users regardless of approval status.

parameters.name: is_revoked
parameters.description: If true, only show users where the management request has been revoked. If false, only show those with a pending or accepted request. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: Encoded-Data-Message
parameters.description: The data that was signed by the user for signature recovery

parameters.name: Encoded-Data-Signature
parameters.description: The signature of data, used for signature recovery
